description: Palettes generated using Fibonacci sequence as hue spacing basis

math_basis.note: Fibonacci ratios converge to 1/φ. The golden angle = 360° × (2 - φ) = 360° / φ²

palettes.name: Fibonacci 5-color (golden angle)
palettes.aesthetic_notes: Maximally spread hues, no clustering. Every color visually distinct. Use for labeling, category data, multi-layer renders.

palettes.name: Fibonacci 8-color neon (golden angle)
palettes.aesthetic_notes: Full saturation at each golden-angle step. Neon rainbow without repetition.

palettes.name: Fibonacci Ratio Progression
palettes.description: Hue spacing based on successive Fibonacci ratios × 360°
palettes.aesthetic_notes: Hue positions spiral toward golden angle. Early colors have wide spacing, later colors converge. Interesting as animation sequence.
